name: Laptop (Windows + WSL2 Ubuntu)
use: Python, Docker, kind, Redfish mockups, Slurm-in-Docker, KWOK, notebooks, writing.

name: Two small Linux VMs (AWS t3.large or VirtualBox)
cost: ~$0.17/h for both on AWS; free on VirtualBox
use: Things WSL can't do: kernel modules (Soft-RoCE), perf, real NICs, PXE.

name: One GPU, spot (g4dn.xlarge T4 16 GB or g5.xlarge A10G 24 GB)
use: Drivers, DCGM, burn-in, containers, GPU Operator, vLLM, metrics.

name: One multi-GPU node (g4dn.12xlarge 4xT4 or g5.12xlarge 4xA10G)
use: nccl-tests on one node, torchrun, Slurm with real GPUs, topology. No NVLink on these - PCIe only.

name: Two EFA nodes in a cluster placement group (2 x g4dn.12xlarge)
cost: ~$8/h on-demand for both - run 2-3 h, then destroy
use: EFA, multi-node NCCL, scaling, bisection. Use NVIDIA LaunchPad / a borrowed InfiniBand cluster for IB-only labs.

name: Rented A100/H100 by the hour (GPU cloud or NVIDIA LaunchPad)
use: MIG (needs A100/H100), NVLink/NVSwitch, GPUDirect RDMA, real fabric.
